arxiv-2007-08357.title: Substring Complexity in Sublinear Space
arxiv-2007-08357.creator: Giulia Bernardini, Gabriele Fici, Paweł Gawrychowski, Solon P. Pissis
arxiv-2007-08357.description: Abstract Shannon’s entropy is a definitive lower bound for statistical compression. Unfortunately, no such clear measure exists for the compressibility of repetitive strings. Thus, ad hoc measures are employed to estimate the repetitiveness of strings, e.g., the size z z of the Lempel–Ziv parse or the number r r of equal-letter runs of the Burrows-Wheeler transform.

arxiv-2107-10388.title: JS Fake Chorales: a Synthetic Dataset of Polyphonic Music with Human Annotation
arxiv-2107-10388.creator: Omar A. Peracha
arxiv-2107-10388.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Omar A. Peracha. High-quality datasets for learning-based modelling of polyphonic symbolic music remain less readily-accessible at scale than in other domains, such as language modelling or image classification. Deep learning algorithms show great potential for enabling the widespread use of interactive music generation technology in consumer applications, but the lack of large-scale datasets remains a bottleneck for the development of algorithms that can consistently generate high-quality outputs.

arxiv-2401-03981.title: Discretisation of an Oldroyd-B viscoelastic fluid flow using a Lie derivative formulation
arxiv-2401-03981.creator: Ben S. Ashby, Tristan Pryer
arxiv-2401-03981.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Ben S. Ashby, Tristan Pryer. In this article we present a numerical method for the Stokes flow of an Oldroyd-B fluid. The viscoelastic stress evolves according to a constitutive law formulated in terms of the upper convected time derivative. A finite difference method is used to discretise along fluid trajectories to approximate the advection and deformation terms of the upper convected derivative in a simple, cheap and cohesive manner, as well as ensuring that the discrete conformation tensor is positive definite.

pmc-11391738.title: Identification of zinc finger MIZ-type containing 2 as an oncoprotein enhancing NAD-dependent protein deacetylase sirtuin-1 deacetylase activity to regulate Wnt and Hippo pathways in non-small-cell lung cancer
pmc-11391738.creator: Xueting Gan, Yuheng Feng, Yang Liu, Xuyong Lin, Xinmiao Yu, Xuezhu Rong, Qiang Han
pmc-11391738.description: BackgroundZinc finger MIZ-type containing 2 (ZMIZ2) can function as a coactivator and participate in the progression of certain malignant tumors; however, its expression and underlying molecular mechanism in non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) remains unknown. In this study, we aim to analyze the expression of ZMIZ2 and its tumorigenic function in NSCLC, identifying its related factors.

pmc-11515484.title: Barriers and facilitators to culturally sensitive care in general practice: a reflexive thematic analysis
pmc-11515484.creator: Robin Vandecasteele, Lenzo Robijn, Sara Willems, Stéphanie De Maesschalck, Peter A J Stevens
pmc-11515484.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundThis study investigated the perceived barriers and potential facilitators for culturally sensitive care among general practitioners in Flanders. Understanding these dynamics is crucial for improving healthcare quality and equity.MethodologyTwenty-one in-depth interviews were conducted with Flemish GPs. Braun and Clarke’s reflexive thematic analysis was employed to develop and interpret themes that elucidate shared underlying meanings and capture the nuanced challenges and strategies related to cultural sensitivity in healthcare.ResultsTwo core themes were generated: GPs’ uncertainty and opposition.

pmc-12505583.title: Acceptability and factors associated with minimum postpartum stay in public health facilities among mothers in Mekelle: a mixed-methods study
pmc-12505583.creator: Gebretsadik Kiros Lema, Haftamu Ebuy, Ytbarek Tadesse, Mache Tsadik
pmc-12505583.description: BackgroundPostnatal care in Ethiopia is often neglected. The WHO recommends mothers stay at health facilities for at least 24 hours after delivery, but information on the acceptability is lacking. This study aimed to assess the acceptability and factors associated with minimum postpartum stay at public health facilities among mothers in Mekelle in 2020.

pmc-12538433.title: Balancing secondary intention and reconstruction in nail apparatus melanoma: Plastic surgery insight from a case serie
pmc-12538433.creator: Elise Lupon, Luc Chouquet, Olivier Camuzard
pmc-12538433.description:
A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Highlights•Secondary intention healing remains an option for nail apparatus melanoma.•Healing time is long and cosmetic results can be unpredictable.•Local flaps or dermal substitutes allow faster healing and better outcomes.•Perforator flaps can improve comfort and long-term functional results.Keywords: Nail apparatus melanoma, Secondary intention healing, Dermal substitute, Perforator flap, Reconstructive surgery

Melanoma of the nail apparatus is a rare entity that often poses difficult reconstructive dilemmas, which remain relatively unfamiliar to many plastic surgeons and dermatologists given the recent interest in this topic.

pmc-12740869.description: ObjectiveThis study aims to conduct a comparative analysis of the effects of different physical therapies on the pain, fatigue, functional impairment, quality of life, and grip strength of breast cancer survivors. pmc-13054806.creator: Zoha Heidarinejad, Mahdi Farzadkia, Seyyed Mohammad Mousavi
pmc-13054806.description: All over the world, a large amount of electric arc furnace (EAF) slag is produced in the iron and steel industries every year, and the correct management of these by-products is the main problem of these industries. Therefore, the complete characterization of these slags is effective in choosing the correct method for their management.

pmc-13266566.title: Associations of birth size with BMI trajectories and fluctuation across adolescence and adulthood: A longitudinal study of two Finnish twin cohorts
pmc-13266566.creator: Alvaro Obeso, Aline Jelenkovic, Gabin Drouard, Jaakko Kaprio, Karri Silventoinen
pmc-13266566.description: Introduction:The influence of intrauterine conditions on later weight gain remains unclear. We examined the associations of birth size characteristics (weight, length, and ponderal index (PI)) with body mass index (BMI) trajectories and fluctuation in adolescence and adulthood using a twin design, which provides insights into the role of genetic and environmental factors.

pmc-13294310.creator: Louise Stinat, Marie Bonnin, Jean-Christophe Gimel, Amandine Gastebois, Bienvenue Razafimandimby, Emilie Tireau, Nolwenn Lautram, David Dallerac, Guillaume Lefebvre, Sylvain Verron, Brice Calvignac, Sylvie Crauste-Manciet, Frederic Lagarce
pmc-13294310.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Fungal keratitis is a serious corneal infection with a limited therapeutic panel. Voriconazole, an azole antifungal, has been shown to be effective against many of the fungal strains involved in this type of infection. The absence of an ocular dedicated formulation on the market has led to the use of the sterile commercial cyclodextrin based formulation as a hospital preparation with some drawbacks. The aim of this study was to design a dedicated formulation for ocular delivery using oil-in-water nanoemulsion.

uslaw-usc-t46-s104.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t46-s104.description: United States Code, Title 46 (Shipping); Chapter 1 (Definitions). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel.
